reviews.review_msg: Dr. Mohlabeng is a good professor if you're prepared to work outside of class. Teaches by example but the homework doesn't match the exam questions. Made it impossible to study for the midterm because there weren't enough questions to practice on. Lectures aren't mandatory, but if you have a content heavy class you should go and take lots of notes
He's your average professor, idk why he's receiving so many bad reviews. Overall, lectures were interactive but you will need to put a lot of time outside class.

I had hid for Phys 344. The final was really hard, but his lecture notes were actually pretty good and really clear. Definitely need to use the textbook and do lots of practice problems. And ask plenty of questions!
Getting mixed up in examples constantly to asking questions that were nonsensical, Gopolang did it all. Glad I'll never be having him again.
Not going to Professor Molabeng's lectures was the right decision.
NEVER TAKE THIS MAN AGAIN I ALMOST LOST MY HAIR. HE LITERALLY IS SATAN AND I WILL NOT EVER LOOK AT THIS MAN THE SAME. I HATED THIS SO MUCH SAVE YOURSELF.

Difficult class and he did not make it any easier to understand, he often made mistakes in lectures. His exams were not the most difficult but his way of explaining made it very hard to understand, it was like he was speaking in only math terms and made little effort to elaborate. Not the worst prof I've had by a long shot but not great either.
He tries his best to explain and offers a lot of help outside of class, but his test are a bit over complicated. Just make sure to study A LOT
